verdict.rationale: doola's own Registered Agent service handles incoming physical mail and gives the company digital access to it through the dashboard. That gets the content of certified mail to the company in scanned form. Nothing shows original documents or checks being physically forwarded, or a written forwarding policy. Missing for 10: documented forwarding of original documents, handling of checks and certified mail specifically, a published forwarding policy (timelines, fees, destinations), independent or hands-on corroboration.
